bundled.built_from: Unmodified /usr/share/nginx/html layer of the official ghcr.io/drawdb-io/drawdb:v1.8.2 linux/amd64 image, produced by the upstream release workflow from tag v1.8.2. The corresponding tag source is included via downloads.

modifications: Product assets are unchanged. The static server and runtime apply the serving and navigation policies described in configuration.
configuration: server.py serves the files of the image layer byte for byte, answers /config.js as the release image does when no backend is configured (window.__DRAWDB_CONFIG__ = { backendUrl: "", gistBackendUrl: "" };) and answers index.html for every other path, as the image's nginx configuration (try_files $uri /index.html) does. No product file is modified. The static server applies CSP to the actual documents; the runtime checks final documents and restricts script navigation.

notes.source_availability: drawdb-1.8.2-source.tar.gz is the complete corresponding source of the build (the tag archive, with package-lock.json pinning every bundled dependency).
notes.shared_browser_resources: Bootstrap Icons 1.11.1, Font Awesome Free 6.5.2 and Monaco Editor 0.52.2 are mirrored npm resources available to every runtime target.
